name: Nominatim
description: A tool to search OpenStreetMap data by name and address (geocoding) and to generate synthetic addresses of OSM points (reverse geocoding). See all available configuration options: https://github.com/mediagis/nominatim-docker/blob/master/4.5/README.md#general-parameters

paths.name: Data Storage Path
paths.description: Path to store the app data

variables.name: PBF File URL
variables.description: URL of the OpenStreetMaps data extract (.pbf file) to import. See https://github.com/mediagis/nominatim-docker/tree/master/4.5#openstreetmap-data-extracts

variables.name: Replication URL
variables.description: URL of where to get updates from
